summary: SQLite rebuild failed because a worker-created live_sources JSON used unsupported top-level fields metadata and source_level.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 34705513672 failed in scripts/build_db.py with unknown columns ['metadata', 'source_level'] for data/sources/other/LIVE_20170610_001_transcript_copy.json.
resolution_notes: Normalized the source record to the existing live_sources contract: source-level/provenance details are preserved inside metadata_json and notes rather than unsupported top-level columns. CI must be rechecked for further data-contract failures.
